question: I am developing an SnO2 n-i-p perovskite solar cell. What can I do to improve the PCE, and what does the literature say about improving these devices?
final_answer: ML model: baseline 12.34%; switching the perovskite from MAPbI3 to CsMAFA raises the prediction to 15.52% (+3.18 pp). Literature: chloride additives (FACl) plus ADAHCl passivation improve SnO2 n-i-p devices, with a champion PCE of 21.2% (DOI 10.1002/aenm.201803587).
